companyDescription: Autonomous defense platform · DZYNE acquired Jul 6 ($875.8M) · FY26 revenue guide raised to $525M (from $390M) · Sentrycs in Lockheed Sanctum C2 · Counter-UAS + ISR + kinetic effects
priceNote: Up ~1.4% Jul 6 on DZYNE acquisition close + FY26 guide raised to $525M. Still -33% YTD — insider/resale overhang persists alongside transformative M&A.
summary: Ondas closed the transformative DZYNE Technologies acquisition on Jul 6, 2026 ($875.8M cash+stock), raising its FY2026 revenue target to at least $525M from $390M. DZYNE adds ULTRA long-endurance ISR, IonStrike kinetic interceptor, and Dronebuster counter-UAS — expected $191M revenue in 2026. Combined with Omnisys (closed May 21), Ondas is now a vanguard multi-domain autonomous defense platform. 9 analysts avg PT $20.13 (+163%). Near-term overhang from insider/resale selling remains, but the DZYNE deal materially upgrades the revenue trajectory.

catalysts.name: DZYNE Acquisition Closed — FY26 Guide $525M
catalysts.description: Jul 6, 2026: Ondas acquired DZYNE for $875.8M ($200M cash + ~85M shares). FY2026 revenue target raised to at least $525M from $390M. DZYNE expected $191M rev in 2026, EBITDA positive. Cyberhawk close (Q3) not yet in guide.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Est. Aug 11, 2026. First report post-DZYNE/Omnisys — tests whether $525M FY guide is credible and Q2 orders ($150M+) convert to revenue. Watch pro-forma backlog and gross margin.

catalysts.name: Insider / Resale Share Overhang
catalysts.description: CEO sold $31.9M; 3.378M-share resale registration (Jun 26); DZYNE deal adds ~85M new shares (50%+ locked 6 months). Supply pressure continues despite fundamentals upgrade.

catalysts.name: Cyberhawk Acquisition Close
catalysts.description: $125M — AI drone inspection for critical infrastructure. Expected Q3 2026 close; not in current $525M guide.

risks: DZYNE integration risk — $875.8M deal adds complexity; 85M new shares dilute existing holders (13.8% to DZYNE shareholders)
Insider/resale overhang persists — supply pressure may continue despite DZYNE fundamentals upgrade
Pre-profit cash burn — integration costs + acquisition financing ($200M cash component)
Q2 est. revenue $65.8M (Benzinga) vs $525M FY guide requires massive H2 ramp — execution risk
Short interest ~33% of float — volatile two-way trading

estimateDates.note: Pro-forma revenue + $525M FY guide credibility test

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds held at 3.50-3.75% since a string of meetings; FedWatch prices an ~89% probability of another hold at the Jul 28-29 FOMC. As a pre-profit, financing-dependent small-cap, Ondas is more rate-sensitive than a self-funding business — a higher-for-longer path raises the cost of any future capital raise.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Next CPI print (June data) is Jul 14, 2026, ahead of the FOMC meeting. A hot print would reinforce the Fed's already-hawkish lean and pressure high-beta growth names like ONDS further.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM. Defense/homeland-security program spending itself is policy-driven and largely rate-insensitive, but ONDS's own equity financing and trading multiple are exposed to the broader hawkish-Fed backdrop (10yr yield ~4.48%) more than the underlying government-contract business is.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — the Jul 29 FOMC decision itself is well-telegraphed as a hold, so it's not a near-term surprise risk. The bigger macro sensitivity is ONDS's rate-exposed, pre-profit balance sheet, not the FOMC meeting date itself.

entryStrategy.verdict: Buy the DZYNE transformation — FY guide +35% to $525M is a step-change. Overhang caps near-term upside; scale in 3-5% and add on dips. Q2 Aug 11 is the proof point.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Ondas has historically run hard into and after strong quarterly prints — the stock ran from roughly $7 to $13.36 in June 2026 on Q1 beat and backlog-growth momentum, before the current insider-selling pullback interrupted it.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 2-4 สัปดาห์ก่อน earnings, ตาม order-flow newsflow

postWin.note: AeroVironment (AVAV), a comparable defense-drone name, jumped 19% on a strong earnings beat tied to the broader defense-spending surge (Jun 30, 2026). Ondas's own June 2026 run (~$7 to $13.36) on its Q1 beat and backlog growth is the more direct historical comp for this exact stock.

postLose.note: A guidance cut or evidence that the $4.3B pipeline isn't converting would remove the core bull thesis and likely trigger a sharp re-rate, on top of the existing dilution overhang.
postLose.exampleDate: Typical pattern for guidance-dependent small-cap defense names

spotSizing.reason: 4% — moderate speculative sizing. Fundamentals and analyst conviction are both strong, but real, ongoing share-supply overhang (insider sales, resale registrations, Form 144) and pre-profit cash burn keep this in speculative-sizing territory, not core-holding territory.
